genius.notes: GYEN has NYDFS trust-company supervision and monthly attestations, but no public GENIUS state-qualified approval or official application source was located. GMO-Z.com Trust Company announced a wind-down of GYEN and ZUSD issuance on May 15, 2026, with the parent GMO Internet Group dissolving the subsidiary and recording a ¥2.2bn write-down; the entity is pursuing a strategic shift to Japan. No GENIUS authorization posture is expected to develop given the planned dissolution.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: NYDFS trust-company and reserve-attestation materials were found, but no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for GYEN. GMO-Z.com Trust Company announced dissolution of its U.S. stablecoin operations on May 15, 2026, making future authorization pursuit unlikely.
